text.p: Here are the highlights of stories in the Skopje press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- "Macedonia can survive as a civil state," President Kiro Gligorov says in an interview with Croatian weekly "Tjednik", explaining how he managed to keep Macedonia out of the war, reasons why the war started in former Yugoslavia and role of nationalist parties.
- German auto manufacturer Audi is not going to build a car factory in Macedonia.

- Association of ethnic Macedonians in Bulgaria "OMO Ilinden" call on Skopje to ratify European Council convention on protection of minorities. It will also call for new internationally monitored census in Bulgaria to include its own ethnic group.
- The Federation of Macedonian Trade Unions says proposed reduction of maternity leave and minimal holidays is unconstitutional.

- Arben Dzaferi, leader of the Democratic Party of Albanians, denies Macedonism and says the Macedonians have usurped the history of other Balkan nations. -- Mircela Casule, Skopje newsroom +389 91 201 196
